normal.name: Canon-Thought
normal.text: I was already a middle school kid who was into horror. The school library was full of awesome stuff. That, and late-night sci-fi channel, is how I fell in love with the anthology horror format. So the first chance to play a PC game that was horror? I dived at it

heated.name: Starboard Bow Games
heated.text: Bought an old game on GOG. I thought the enemy AI was completely broken until I capped the FPS at 30 in the settings file. Old games tied everything to framerate, no delta time. Your PC runs it too fast and the AI loses its mind. That is why we use delta time now.
